name: leftovers
summary: Finds the mess a bot leaves behind without being told: scaffolding pillars and strays it placed and never took down (from the provenance ledger), and trees cut only part of the way up (logs standing on nothing, keeping a canopy alive). Reports through telemetry flags, journal events and brain/state/leftovers.json so the memory loop opens work orders by itself. Never moves the bot or touches a block.
